sections.title: Arsenal
sections.html:
Arsenal Women

Arsenal won 2–1 at Liverpool, with Alessia Russo scoring in the 9th minute (Emily Fox assisting) and the 45th (Lisa Baum), and they climbed from eighth to sixth on 13 points. Liverpool, with Beata Olsson's goal, dropped to 12th.

Manchester United and Aston Villa drew 4–4, with Alysson and Nicolas Jackson scoring for Villa inside the first four minutes. Zirkzee and Dorgu then scored in stoppage time for United.

Villa are 10th on 13 points, up from 12th; United are 18th on 8.

Liverpool won 3–1 at Crystal Palace, with goals from Alexis Mac Allister, Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak. Eddie Nketiah scored a penalty for Palace in stoppage time.

Liverpool climbed from sixth to fourth on 18 points; Palace are 20th on 7.

Sunderland beat Chelsea 1–0, Enzo Le Fée scoring a penalty in the 36th minute.

Sunderland rose from 20th to 19th on 8 points. Chelsea dropped from fourth to fifth on 16.

Brighton & Hove Albion beat Brentford 2–0, with goals from Diego Gómez and a Pascal Gross penalty. Brentford's Igor Thiago was sent off in the 23rd minute.

Brighton climbed from third to second on 22 points; Brentford dropped from seventh to eighth.

AFC Bournemouth won 2–1 at Ipswich Town. Evanilson scored early, Leif Davis put through his own net just after the break, and Jack Clarke pulled one back from the penalty spot in the 73rd minute.

Bournemouth climbed from ninth to seventh on 15 points; Ipswich are 14th on 11.

sections.title: Young Guns
sections.html:
• Yaxel Lendeborg (GSW, 24), a rookie, scored 23 points and blocked 3 shots against the Orlando Magic. A fine night's work.
  • Nolan Traore (BKN, 20) scored 19 points and made 4 steals against the Atlanta Hawks, a lively all-round showing.
  • Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes, 20) finished 5th in the Brazilian Grand Prix, collecting points and setting the fastest lap along the way.
  • Arvell Reese (NYG, 21), a rookie, brought down the quarterback with 3 sacks, a busy day for the young defender.
  • Caleb Downs (DAL, 21), a rookie, recorded 1 sack and 1 interception, making his mark in both areas of the defence.
